## Activity

During February 2023, West Gate Eye Clinic recorded 389 captures. This is the activity total for the reporting month. The figure provides the basis for reviewing image quality and the subsequent grading workload.

## Image quality

Of the 389 captures, 13 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 3.3 per cent. These results are reported together to show both the number of captures that could not be graded and their proportion of total activity.

## Grading

Grading identified 93 referable results. The median lag between capture and grading was 2 days. The referable result count and median lag summarise the grading outcome and the time taken for images to progress through the process during February 2023.
